issue_context.title: Weather effect faster with higher framerate
issue_context.body:
Snow particles move much faster with higher framerate.
Tested with Playtest 20200426 and Releasse 20200503, on 60Hz Monitor, Win10 and over 900 FPS. Also notable with 120 FPS. I guess it's the same with higher refresh rate Panels.

Reproduce:

- Disable VSync and Frame Limiter in Settings
- Start Game on Snow Themed Map with Snow a weather effect
- With 900 Frames the Snow particle jump around
comments: While this is something we should fix, since it can be worked around with VSync/frame limit this shouldn't delay the next release, so moving to Next+1.

review_comments:
`tickFraction` looks like something we might want to eventually calculate and expose at a central, publicly accessible place like `Game`, so we can reuse it for things like interpolation and don't need to do the math locally in every place that needs it.

Just thinking aloud, not a request for this particular PR.
You are thinking of something like https://love2d.org/wiki/dt delta time?
